Seaview restaurants to enjoy fresh seafood in Vietnamese style
Jan 2019 • Friends
Went here with my colleagues in the heavy afternoon and not regret at all..
We order sea snails in soup, Vietnamese fish springroll ("raw anchovy-looked alike fish" with peanuts, chilli and herbs + raw vegetables + cilantro leaves rolled in thin rice paper), mango salad, sweet and sour seafood soup, fried squid eith garlic.
Served with rice crackers with sesame and 4 kinds of dipping sauces, all in their best!
The seafood is fresh, you can taste the original flavor, balanced very well with the dipping sauces. Generous portion of raw vegetables, mix together with the seafood.
The place is popular for locals, located just opposite of the beach. Direct view to the sea, sitting area in 2nd floor is better. We arrived around 5.30 pm and still empty but in a minutes full with crowds and families. They don't served fruit juices here like what I usually have in Indonesia, instead redbull and local beers are everywhere.
My colleagues told me this place also served beef and chicken, but they are famous for the seafood.

Fabulous experience with the locals
Apr 2017 • Friends
One reviewer said he or she and party were the only foreigners in this enormous establishment, and that's one reason we went - to get an authentic experience.
Boy, howdy. We got it and just loved it.
Seven of us went there tonight, when both upstairs and downstairs were packed. There were noisy parties of 10 and 20 and more, empty cans on the floor, live seafood in bins we passed by on the way to the staircase.
Messy, raucous and just tons of fun. The staff and the patrons were extremely friendly - we were even the subject of a bunch of photos. Because the place was jammed, we got a not-great but perfectly acceptable table, then when a big party finished, we were invited to move out onto the balcony where we could enjoy a fresh breeze.
Four of us had "chicken with onion." The chicken came complete with liver, neck, feet and head. I'm sure lots of folks love it. To us it wasn't a great meal, but was all part of the experience. Others had one beef dish or other and enjoyed them all.
Service was just outstanding.
The restaurant is an easy and pleasant walk from a couple of hotels, and located right on the waterfront. It's not the place for a quiet date night, but is just great if you want to try new things and mix with fun-loving locals.
BTW, dinner for all seven of us, with a couple of soft drinks and lots of beer, was 792,000 VND. That's about $35.50 US. What a steal.
Would we all go back? Absolutely. Haven't had so much fun in a long time.

I'm sure this goes on all the time but here it was very obvious & we left on principle.
